remarks: INVESTORS & OWNER-OCCUPANTS TAKE NOTICE! Opportunity knocks with this spacious Stamford two-family offering an impressive 5 bedrooms, 4 full baths and approximately 2,358 square feet of living space. With two separate living spaces, this property offers tremendous flexibility-ideal as an income-producing investment, an owner-occupied home where rental income can help offset expenses, or a multigenerational living arrangement. Inside, you'll find comfortable room sizes, plenty of natural light and versatile living areas. The inviting covered front porch adds charm and provides the perfect spot to sit and unwind. And don't overlook the generous backyard! There's plenty of outdoor space for entertaining, gardening, barbecues or simply relaxing, with mature landscaping providing a welcome sense of privacy. For investors, the combination of five bedrooms, four full baths, substantial living space and two units creates appealing rental possibilities in the Stamford market. For an owner-occupant, it's an opportunity to enjoy homeownership while potentially having rental income help with monthly expenses. Conveniently located near Stamford's shopping, restaurants, transportation and major commuter routes. Whether you're building your investment portfolio, looking for a home with income potential, or need space for extended family, this Stamford two-family offers possibilities worth exploring.
